t: The Player Detector is able to recognize players within a certain range. In addition, it recognizes the player who clicks on him.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/player_detector/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
玩家侦测器可在一定范围内识别玩家；此外，它还能识别出点击自身的玩家。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/player_detector/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Player Detector to a computer to make use of it!
将你的玩家侦测器连接至计算机即可使用！
